segments.text: Last year, my ex-boyfriend told me he didn’t want to see me any more …
What kind of person does that?
I wasn’t important to him at all.
I think he just wanted me to go away.
When I want to plan something, I generally just send a text.
It’s the same when I cancel plans –
You don’t need to give a long explanation, you know, a lot of reasons.
I hardly ever get cards or presents from friends, or even my brother, and no one calls.
Everyone just writes ‘Happy Birthday’ on my wall on Facebook.
It’s not very friendly, in my opinion.
My daughter is travelling around South America at the moment.
so we know what she’s doing.

Just to know she’s thinking about the family.
